title: Quadrennial
summary: QUADREN'NIAL, adjective [Latin quadriennium; quadra or quadrans, from quatuor, four, and annus, year.] 1. Comprising four years; as a quadrennial period. 2. Occurring once in four years as quadrennial

inlines.v: QUADREN'NIAL, adjective [Latin quadriennium; quadra or quadrans, from quatuor, four, and annus, year.] 1. Comprising four years; as a quadrennial period. 2. Occurring once in four years as quadrennial games.
